title: CAN REASONING MODELS OBFUSCATE REASONING? STRESS-TESTING CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT MONITORABILITY
reasoning: The paper evaluates the ability of LLMs to obfuscate their internal reasoning to evade detection by safety monitors. While it addresses AI alignment and potential deceptive behavior, it focuses on the technical capability of evasion and monitorability rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, moral systems, or ethical frameworks.
